title: Basement Mayem
description: A little ressource pack that one of my friends made for a simple gag, and decided to expand on it (while keeping it survival friendly)
body:
This ressource pack is for **1.20.X**, it's **originally made by a friend of mine** who just made a cursed ressource pack for our friend group, and so had the idea to expand on it, _just a tiny... miniscule... very very tiny bi-_
### **who am I kidding I worked on it for about 2 months :D** _my sanity is going down the drain..._
This pack does NOT contain any explicit material, but makes some references. (thats all there is to it).
It's a pack made for my friends after all...

It also includes some references to some cool ass people you should support your heart out too:
- Element Animation's Villagers voices that they made for April Fools. Cause damn this pack is awesome !
- Baba and Keke from [Baba Is You](https://store.steampowered.com/app/736260/Baba_Is_You/) by Arvi Teikari ! Cool game that breaks itself :)
- And... uhhhh i dont remember the res- oh yeah ! [The Sans under Tale !](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/sand-undertale)

Will definetly add more to it if I find time :D
This is a meme pack. Dont take it seriously... like come on... I know you are going to complain about it on twitter while i explain my true intentions RIGHT HERE. So please do not the stupid.

Also you may use this pack for anything, videos, images, posts etc. All I really wanna ask is providing the source of it and even better if you include a link to it ❤ thnak
